payload.gaps:
FIVE ENTRIES ADDED TO THE REGISTER, each with an owner and a trigger. Every unfilled slide, every at-risk scenario and every deferred concern from the validation walk is here — nothing was left in prose only.

1. se.raid-the-killer-story-that-could-not-be-demonstrated — THE LARGEST GAP.
  OWNER: the next iteration, already ruled and scoped by the owner. TRIGGER: closed when a packet demonstrably carries a rule the agent did not go looking for.
  A killer story ended the iteration unfillable. Ten notes and four laws minted today reach no packet tomorrow. And the iteration demonstrated the failure on itself — its first pass recorded a decision, its rewalk contradicted that decision two hours later, and nothing carried it to the state that needed it.

2. se.raid-the-parallel-agent-scenario-is-unexercised.
  OWNER: whoever first runs two iterations at once. TRIGGER: fires the first time a second agent opens an iteration while another is live.
  Promotion is proven six times over; two agents running simultaneously against one judge has never happened. The ambiguous-root refusal is tested on synthetic roots and untested live. Acceptable to carry because every part is individually tested and the failure would be a refusal rather than a wrong answer — but it becomes urgent the moment anyone fans chunks out to sub-agents.

3. se.raid-the-register-is-silent-about-operating-the-system — THE PATTERN ENTRY.
  OWNER: the next requirements author. TRIGGER: any further ask that no check covers and that concerns using the system rather than recording with it.
  Three gaps on one axis, found three different ways, none by a gate: nothing requires the system to be unobtrusive while it runs; nothing covers the entry point; nothing required a refusal to diagnose rather than merely refuse. Thirty-eight requirements cover what the machine records. None covers what operating it is like. The owner appears in the stories as someone who READS the record, never as someone who OPERATES the tool — which is why every one of these was found by a complaint rather than by a check.

4. se.raid-a-criterion-ran-at-full-weight-with-no-definition.
  OWNER: the next decision author. TRIGGER: any criteria set entering a Pugh run.
  One-click installability decided an architecture across two milestones without anyone writing down what it meant. No gate, round or lint caught it, because a sentence WAS present — it described a virtue rather than an observable, and nothing distinguishes those. The checkable version is nearly mechanical: a criterion's definition must name something a candidate could fail.
  IT ALSO CARRIES A SECOND-ORDER LESSON that cost more than the first: a flip turning on someone's INTENT deserves more weight than one turning on a measurement. Flagged as high-credibility, routed to the owner, and then walked past anyway. The identical mistake is recorded one milestone earlier in the superseded search decision. Twice in one iteration.

5. se.raid-the-engine-inherits-everything-by-default.
  OWNER: the engine. TRIGGER: any new spawn site, or any fourth inherited-state defect.
  Three defects, one cause: children inherit the parent's whole environment. A suite that ran nothing and reported green; a suite verifying against the live session's admission; sixteen spawns flashing focus-stealing windows. Each fixed by deleting one variable as it bit — which is a blacklist, and the owner's standing law says guards are whitelists. There is no reason to believe the list of three is complete, and two of the three failed SILENTLY.

NOT ADDED, and the omission is deliberate in each case:
  THE UNTESTED COLON-IN-PATH CASE — already carried inside the search decision as an open edge that matters only if the fallback design is ever taken.
  THE CHUNK MACHINE AS A PLAN RATHER THAN A DRAWING — already an accepted-debt entry from the previous iteration's ship; re-minting it would put one fact in two places.
  THE PROMOTION'S POOR DIAGNOSIS — captured as note-bbbe848d102d with its five distinct failures as a requirement list, at the owner's instruction that it be improved next iteration. Kept as a note rather than a register entry because it is scoped work with a destination, not an open risk.

ONE OBSERVATION ABOUT THIS SET, worth more than any single entry: four of the five are about the SAME shape — something required, obvious in hindsight, and collected by nothing. The rounds that found them are the first instrument this project has had that asks a question no one remembered to ask.
